methods.name: Stage-Progression
methods.rationale: Applies typical Series B → next-stage step-up multiplier (1.9x) to $60M total raised proxy.

methods.name: Peer-Median
methods.rationale: Median across 3 same-sector + same/adjacent-stage peers in Climate & Energy. Range: $700M - $3.0B.

public.rationale: Public-co frontier-tech comp in Climate & Bio-Manufacturing

data.narrative:
TS Conductor is a Series B climate and energy company that has raised $60M to date. The valuation analysis draws on a peer set of three same-sector, same-stage comparables—KoBold Metals, Electric Hydrogen, and Amogy, all valued between $700M and $3.0B at the Series C stage—alongside a broader universe of nine private and one public company in the Climate & Energy sector.

Two triangulation methods were applied. The stage-progression method uses the company's $60M in total raised as a proxy and applies a typical Series B-to-next-stage multiplier of 1.9x, implying a valuation of $114M. The peer-median method anchors on the three nearest comparables, which have a median valuation of $1.0B, implying equivalent value for TS Conductor on a same-stage basis, though this likely overstates given the peer set consists of Series C (later-stage) companies.

The triangulated analysis supports a range of $97M (low) to $1.1B (high), with a median of $557M. The wide spread reflects material stage and maturity differences within the peer set. Key uncertainties include commercialization trajectory relative to Series C peers and capital intensity of the underlying business model. The stage-progression and peer-adjusted analyses suggest a valuation in the low-to-mid $100M range is most defensible for a Series B round.
